proposed.title: Jessica Jones S2#2
proposed.text: Jessica questions Simpson, who says he is only protecting Trish from IGH. When the killer finds them, he tells Jessica to take Trish and run, and he is killed.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A cop who turns on Jessica, then dies covering her and Trish's escape.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The investigator Simpson turns on, then helps escape before he dies.

changes.evidence: In JJ S2E2 'AKA Freak Accident' Trish ties Simpson up and calls Jessica, who interrogates him and comes to believe he was only protecting Trish; when Alisa attacks he tells Jessica to take Trish and run, she unties him, and he is killed. A clear turn from enemy back to ally, ending in his death, with no stage.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S2#6
proposed.text: Jessica hunts down Karl Malus, the IGH doctor who experimented on her, and finds him living with a woman who claims to be her mother.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The IGH doctor who experimented on Jessica, whom she hunts down.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A woman Malus experimented on, who hunts him down.

changes.evidence: The connection starts well before S2E11: Jessica spots Malus at the aquarium (S2E5), tracks him to his house and finds him with Alisa (S2E6), he sedates her (S2E7), tells her he saved her and she calls the police on him (S2E8), and she helps him flee (S2E10). Only S2E11 has a stage.

proposed.title: The Defenders#2
proposed.text: Misty Knight catches Jessica taking evidence from a crime scene, then arrests her and questions her at the precinct.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An NYPD detective who arrests Jessica for meddling in her case.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An investigator Misty arrests for meddling in her case.

changes.evidence: They meet in The Defenders E2 'Mean Right Hook': Misty sees Jessica take evidence at John Raymond's hideout, arrests her outside her building and interrogates her until Matt walks in as her lawyer. The only stage is at #7.

proposed.title: The Defenders#6
proposed.text: Jessica and Matt come back to find Stick trying to kill Danny to keep him from the Hand, and Elektra kills Stick in front of them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The blind old man who turns on Danny and is killed by Elektra.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Defender who walks out on Stick, then sees Elektra kill him.

changes.evidence: In The Defenders E6 'Ashes, Ashes' Jessica and Matt return to find Stick attempting to murder Danny; Elektra defeats Stick and kills him as Matt and Jessica charge in. A betrayal and a death with no stage.

proposed.title: Daredevil S1#2
proposed.text: Josie serves Karen and Foggy at her bar, tells them they cannot drink for free, and tells Karen she could do better than Foggy.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A regular who drinks at Josie's bar with her friends.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The owner of the bar where Karen and her friends drink.

changes.evidence: In Daredevil S1E2 'Cut Man' Josie serves Foggy and Karen and tells Karen 'You could do so much better, love'; Karen is a regular at Josie's through Daredevil S1 and S2. The connection starts there, not at Born Again S2#2.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#13

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Pilgrim's bosses, until he takes his sons back from them.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Schultzes' hired killer, until he takes his sons back from them.

changes.evidence: In The Punisher S2E13 'The Whirlwind' Pilgrim tells Castle the Schultzes hold his sons, asks him to spare the boys, then rides with Castle and Amy to the Schultz mansion and rescues his sons while Castle shoots Eliza and leaves Anderson to kill himself. The bosses' hold on him ends with no stage.

The bosses' hold on him ends with no stage.

The only tie is an anonymous leak: in Born Again S2E3 Karen anonymously sends McCaffrey the Charter of the Port of Red Hook, so McCaffrey does not know who sent it (the card line on McCaffrey's side assumes she does). No on-screen exchange between them is recorded in S2E3 to S2E8; this is knowing about someone.

Their only shared moment is JJ S3E13: Jessica ambushes Trish at Jeri's apartment and Trish grabs Kith as a hostage. Jessica's fight is with Trish; she and Kith never exchange anything on screen in S3. Sharing a scene or a fight is not a connection.
